title: Coupling Without Correspondence: Shared-Weight Learning Across Unpaired Cohorts
description: PhD dissertation. Depression datasets rarely share participants or modalities. This work couples three subject-disjoint cohorts (MODMA EEG, DAIC-WOZ English audio and text, CMDC Chinese audio and text) through shared backbone and classifier weights, with no explicit alignment objective, so each modality learns from the others without paired data.

title: FB-Siam: Frequency-Band Siamese Network for EEG Depression Detection
description: A Siamese network that learns depression markers within individual EEG frequency bands, validated across datasets rather than within a single cohort. Published in IEEE Sensors Journal.

title: MS-HRVNet: Anxiety Detection from Short Heart-Rate Windows
description: Multi-scale residual learning that detects anxiety events from short windows of heart rate variability, evaluated on the PhysioNet ECG-Spider dataset. Best Paper at ASK 2026; journal version accepted at JIPS.

title: HANA TALK Translation System
description: A translation system built for an industry-academic AI hackathon. Won the Gold Prize at the 2025 Industry-Academic Cooperation and AI Hackathon Competition.

title: ACMA: Additive Cross-Modal Attention for Depression Detection
description: An attention mechanism that fuses audio and textual features from clinical interviews for depression detection. Published in IEEE Access.

title: Document and ID Card Masking
description: Automated masking of personal information in documents, including Korean ID card anonymization. Encouragement Award, 2023 AI Industry-Academic Cooperation Project.
